candidate_rule: Uniform random nonempty prefix of each natural trace; fair coin replaces one uniformly chosen action or noninitial state with a uniformly sampled catalogue value (including unchanged). No rejection resampling or informative-negative filtering.
positive_rule: All arms receive natural goods plus every oracle-accepted candidate. A discards negative labels, B receives equally many legacy paired negatives, C receives all oracle-rejected candidates.
symbolic: lexicographically first total deterministic feasible model; both A and C
selection: Fixed final epochs and historical hyperparameters; no tuning or model selection
scope: Resource-bounded pilot: first layout and unrotated member of every existing family, selected by index before training, not outcomes
statistics: Paired descriptive contrasts; family/layout is structural block. Seeds and nested budgets are repeated measurements. Three related fixed families do not support population-level significance claims.
